title: KOSOVO TIME II
rule: the real sun over Kosovo lights the page at the visitor's time and every screen stands on the ground and casts its computed shadow; nothing on the page explains the mechanism, the time alone says it
description: C-B from the round-11 study. First screen: 'Gentrit Rashiti builds web and mobile apps, from Kosovo.', '5+ years. Part of two platform rewrites. Working remotely.', and one line across the page with today's sun on it; the time ('17:45 in Kosovo') rides beside the disc, and a drag or the arrow keys move the hour. Below the horizon the care team calendar (web, cropped above the 12 PM line) and the Viva Fresh cart (phone) stand on the ground and cast their shadows. Then 'Client work' and 'Own projects', each on a band of the shade colour. The care and Design System rows show the screen and a white work card side by side: the AI line ('Gentrit wrote most of the rules and the checks. AI agents build inside them. A person approves each change.'), the loop and the way back from Checks to Agents build. The care row keeps 16 → 2 as a small proof. The three phone apps stand on one ground on desktop. A pressed plate walks into the case screen that shows the same picture; with no such screen, the page fades.
signature: Fraunces (opsz 144) at 64 px for the one sentence, Public Sans for everything else; four sizes on the first screen (64, 20, 17, 14). Colours come from the sun's altitude (light.ts, unchanged from KOSOVO TIME). New token --k2-band = shade at 30 % over ground: the second surface for section heads and the footer. The floor of the first screen is the WebGL shadow shader (SVG fallback), compiled after the arrival.
holdback: Lowest: original and hooks, 8/10. It is the live home's mechanism with the noise cut, so a reader who knows KOSOVO TIME sees an edit. The walk shows only where the case's first view has the same picture (care calendar, Bayyinah library, Design System picker, Viva cart, Dukagjini, Incentiv); the claims, Viva row and Read to Feed plates fade, because their cases open on another picture. At 4x CPU the route change costs one frame of 150 to 200 ms before the walk starts (the case page renders inside the transition); the walk itself drops no frame. The phone page is 6,194 px, just under the 6,200 target.
